Pinput.doc: Flutter package to create easily customizable Pin code input field.

length.doc: Displayed fields count. PIN code length.

defaultPinTheme.doc: Theme of the pin in default state

focusedPinTheme.doc: Theme of the pin in focused state

submittedPinTheme.doc: Theme of the pin in submitted state

followingPinTheme.doc: Theme of the pin in following state

disabledPinTheme.doc: Theme of the pin in disabled state

errorPinTheme.doc: Theme of the pin in error state

onChanged.doc: Called every time input value changes.

onCompleted.doc: Fires when user completes pin input

onTap.doc: Called when user clicks on PinPut

onLongPress.doc:
Triggered when a pointer has remained in contact with the Pinput at the
same location for a long period of time.

onTapOutside.doc:
A callback to be invoked when a tap is detected outside of this [TapRegion]
The [PointerDownEvent] passed to the function is the event that caused the
notification. If this region is part of a group
then it's possible that the event may be outside of this immediate region,
although it will be within the region of one of the group members.
This is useful if you want to un-focus the [Pinput] when user taps outside of it

onTapUpOutside.doc:
Called for each tap up that occurs outside of the [TextFieldTapRegion]
group when the text field is focused.

preFilledWidget.doc: Widget that is displayed before field submitted.

mainAxisAlignment.doc: Defines how [Pinput] fields are being placed inside [Row]

crossAxisAlignment.doc: Defines how [Pinput] and ([errorText] or [errorBuilder]) are being placed inside [Column]

pinContentAlignment.doc: Defines how each [Pinput] field are being placed within the container

pinAnimationType.doc:
Animation Type of each [Pinput] field
options:
none, scale, fade, slide, rotation

useNativeKeyboard.doc:
Whether to use Native keyboard or custom one
when flag is set to false [Pinput] wont be focusable anymore
so you should set value of [Pinput]'s [TextEditingController] programmatically

toolbarEnabled.doc: If true, paste button will appear on longPress event

obscureText.doc: Whether hide typed pin or not

showCursor.doc:
Whether show cursor or not
Default cursor '|' or [cursor]

enableIMEPersonalizedLearning.doc: Whether to enable that the IME update personalized data such as typing history and user dictionary data.

enableInteractiveSelection.doc:
Whether to enable text selection and interactive features like copy/paste.
When enabled, users can select text, use Ctrl+V to paste, and access context menus.

hapticFeedbackType.doc:
Use haptic feedback everytime user types on keyboard
See more details in [HapticFeedback]

closeKeyboardWhenCompleted.doc: If true keyboard will be closed

slideTransitionBeginOffset.doc: Begin Offset of ever [Pinput] field when [pinAnimationType] is slide

cursor.doc: If [showCursor] true the focused field will show passed Widget

keyboardAppearance.doc:
The appearance of the keyboard.
This setting is only honored on iOS devices.
If unset, defaults to [ThemeData.brightness].

textInputAction.doc: The type of action button to use for the keyboard.

obscuringCharacter.doc:
Provide any symbol to obscure each [Pinput] pin
Recommended ●

obscuringWidget.doc: IF [obscureText] is true typed text will be replaced with passed Widget

onClipboardFound.doc: Fires when clipboard has text of Pinput's length

forceErrorState.doc: If true [errorPinTheme] will be applied and [errorText] will be displayed under the Pinput

showErrorWhenFocused.doc: If true, the error will also be displayed in the focused state. Otherwise the error is not displayed in the focused state.

errorText.doc: Text displayed under the Pinput if Pinput is invalid

pinputAutovalidateMode.doc: Return null if pin is valid or any String otherwise

scrollPadding.doc:
When this widget receives focus and is not completely visible (for example scrolled partially
off the screen or overlapped by the keyboard)
then it will attempt to make itself visible by scrolling a surrounding [Scrollable], if one is present.
This value controls how far from the edges of a [Scrollable] the TextField will be positioned after the scroll.

BlendMode.doc: Algorithms to use when painting on the canvas.

BlurStyle.doc: Styles to use for blurs in [MaskFilter] objects.

BorderStyle.doc: The style of line to draw for a [BorderSide] in a [Border].

BoxFit.doc: How a box should be inscribed into another box.

BoxShape.doc: The shape to use when rendering a [Border] or [BoxDecoration].

Brightness.doc: Describes the contrast of a theme or color palette.

ColorSpace.doc: The color space describes the colors that are available to an [Image].

CrossAxisAlignment.doc: How the children should be placed along the cross axis in a flex layout.

FilterQuality.doc:
Quality levels for image sampling in [ImageFilter] and [Shader] objects that sample
images and for [Canvas] operations that render images.

FontStyle.doc: Whether to use the italic type variation of glyphs in the font.

HapticFeedbackType.doc: The vibration type when user types

ImageRepeat.doc: How to paint any portions of a box not covered by an image.

MainAxisAlignment.doc: How the children should be placed along the main axis in a flex layout.

MaxLengthEnforcement.doc: Mechanisms for enforcing maximum length limits.

PinAnimationType.doc: The animation type if Pin item

PinputAutovalidateMode.doc: The mode which determines the Pinput validation method

TextBaseline.doc: A horizontal line used for aligning text.

TextCapitalization.doc:
Configures how the platform keyboard will select an uppercase or
lowercase keyboard.

TextDecorationStyle.doc: The style in which to draw a text decoration

TextInputAction.doc: An action the user has requested the text input control to perform.

TextOverflow.doc: How overflowing text should be handled.

TileMode.doc: Defines how to handle areas outside the defined bounds of a gradient or image filter.

WebHtmlElementStrategy.doc:
The strategy for [Image.network] and [NetworkImage] to decide whether to
display images in HTML elements contained in a platform view instead of
fetching bytes.

AlignmentGeometry.doc:
Base class for [Alignment] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

AssetBundle.doc: A collection of resources used by the application.

BorderRadiusGeometry.doc: Base class for [BorderRadius] that allows for text-direction aware resolution.

BorderSide.doc: A side of a border of a box.

BoxBorder.doc:
Base class for box borders that can paint as rectangles, circles, or rounded
rectangles.

BoxDecoration.doc: An immutable description of how to paint a box.

BoxShadow.doc: A shadow cast by a box.

Color.doc: An immutable color value in ARGB format.

ColorFilter.doc:
A description of a color filter to apply when drawing a shape or compositing
a layer with a particular [Paint]. A color filter is a function that takes
two colors, and outputs one color. When applied during compositing, it is
independently applied to each pixel of the layer being drawn before the
entire layer is merged with the destination.

Curve.doc:
An parametric animation easing curve, i.e. a mapping of the unit interval to
the unit interval.

DecorationImage.doc: An image for a box decoration.

Duration.doc: A difference between points in time.

EdgeInsets.doc: An immutable set of offsets in each of the four cardinal directions.

EdgeInsetsGeometry.doc:
Base class for [EdgeInsets] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

FontFeature.doc: A feature tag and value that affect the selection of glyphs in a font.

FontVariation.doc: An axis tag and value that can be used to customize variable fonts.

FontWeight.doc: The thickness of the glyphs used to draw the text.

GradientTransform.doc:
Base class for transforming gradient shaders without applying the same
transform to the entire canvas.

ImageProviderOfObject.doc:
Identifies an image without committing to the precise final asset. This
allows a set of images to be identified and for the precise image to later
be resolved based on the environment, e.g. the device pixel ratio.

Locale.doc: An identifier used to select a user's language and formatting preferences.

MouseCursor.doc: An interface for mouse cursor definitions.

Paint.doc: A description of the style to use when drawing on a [Canvas].

Pattern.doc: An interface for basic searches within strings.

PinTheme.doc:
Theme of the individual pin items for following states:
default, focused pin, submitted pin, following pin, disabled pin and error pin

Radius.doc: A radius for either circular or elliptical shapes.

Rect.doc:
An immutable, 2D, axis-aligned, floating-point rectangle whose coordinates
are relative to a given origin.

TextDecoration.doc: A linear decoration to draw near the text.

TextInputFormatter.doc:
A [TextInputFormatter] can be optionally injected into an [EditableText]
to provide as-you-type validation and formatting of the text being edited.

TextInputType.doc: The type of information for which to optimize the text input control.

TextSelectionControls.doc:
An interface for building the selection UI, to be provided by the
implementer of the toolbar widget.

TextStyle.doc: An immutable style describing how to format and paint text.

Uri.doc: A parsed URI, such as a URL.

ViewPadding.doc:
A representation of distances for each of the four edges of a rectangle,
used to encode the view insets and padding that applications should place
around their user interface, as exposed by [FlutterView.viewInsets] and
[FlutterView.padding]. View insets and padding are preferably read via
[MediaQuery.of].
